detail.title: Thermodynamics and Temporal Correlations in Information Engines
detail.summary: This revised notebook synthesizes the role of memory in information engines, identifying that distinct memory states are necessary to leverage temporal correlations in non-Markovian environments. Computational mechanics provides the formal framework (epsilon-transducers) for these states, where optimal prediction directly enables work production.
detail.reason: Incorporating evidence from computational mechanics and thermodynamic engine theory to solidify the definition of operational memory.
